description.en: The ID of the DHCP options set.

description.zh:
要查询DHCP选项集所在的地域ID。


您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the DHCP options set that you want to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc get-dhcp-options-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dhcp-options-set-id dopt-o6w0df4epg9zo8isy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
